fee_notes: Traditional first location: $30,000 (reduced to $24,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)); second+ traditional: $17,500 ($14,000 discounted); non-traditional first: $7,500 ($6,000 discounted); non-traditional second+: $5,000 ($4,000 discounted); LA Fitness location: $15,000 (no military discount applies). No refunds under any circumstances.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for your first traditional NrGize restaurant is $30,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced for your second and each subsequent traditional NrGize restaurant to $17,500. The Initial Franchise Fee for your first non-traditional NrGize restaurant location is $7,500. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced for your second and each subsequent non-traditional NrGize restaurant to $5,000. The initial franchise fee for each of your NrGize restaurants located within an LA Fitness health club is $15,000.
